title: Ribo-Seq / GTI-Seq / ARTseq
reason: scope:GTI-Seq: GTI-Seq is an explicit target of the poster's single grouped upper row. The supplied Wan/Qian TISdb full text establishes an initiation-focused ribosome-profiling variant in which lactimidomycin preferentially freezes initiating ribosomes and their footprints report TIS positions. This supports the purpose and protected-fragment generation at op_rnase. The remaining drawn route stays in the family-level graph: the supplied GTI-Seq passages do not establish the particular two-extraction/rRNA-depletion preparation history of the downstream local instances. Reverse transcription has a matching footprint-to-DNA purpose, but that correspondence alone does not assign this exact downstream instance to GTI-Seq. The upstream inhibitor treatment is not drawn and is described here only to interpret the GTI-Seq target, not added as an operation. The collection page's harringtonine example is not evidence that GTI-Seq uses harringtonine.

candidate.title: Ribo-Seq / GTI-Seq / ARTseq
candidate.scope: The assigned poster's upper RNA-Protein Interactions row is one serial, family-level ribosome-footprint-to-cDNA schematic grouped under Ribo-Seq, GTI-Seq and ARTseq. Ribo-Seq and ARTseq are catalogue aliases here; GTI-Seq is a distinct initiation-focused ribosome-profiling implementation, not an alias. The shared drawing does not establish identical full experimental protocols. The leftmost representative assay icon/caption is descriptive, with no arrow into the working route. The lower, separately labeled RIP-Seq row and decorative border chemistry are outside this card's targets. No branch, pooling, cell indexing, adapter scheme or sequencing instrument is drawn. The diagram ends at cDNA, rather than specifying a complete adapter-ready library.

features: Final single blue line is labeled cDNA; the preceding Reverse transcription icon contains paired purple and blue lines.
RNA sequence information is transferred into a DNA carrier; intact ribosome proteins and the original RNA-protein attachment are not the sequencing carrier.
At Ribo-Seq/ARTseq scope, downstream sequencing of footprint-derived DNA reports ribosome-associated RNA positions and abundances. It is an occupancy snapshot, rather than direct protein detection.
For the initiation-focused GTI-Seq interpretation, initiation-enriched footprints support translation-initiation-site positions. Their read density is not itself an initiation-rate measurement.
The schematic supplies no adapters, amplification architecture or explicit mechanism for obtaining the final cDNA-only representation.

evidence.locator: Full text [b00008], three necessary steps
evidence.quote: To establish ribosome profiling as a quantitative tool for monitoring translation, we needed to implement three steps: (i) robustly generate ribosome-protected mRNA fragments (“footprints”) whose sequences indicate the position of active ribosomes; (ii) convert these RNA footprints into a library of DNA molecules in a form that is suitable for deep sequencing with minimal distortion; and (iii) measure the abundance of different footprints in this library by means of deep sequencing.

evidence.locator: Full text [b00007], GTI-Seq rationale
evidence.quote: The rationale of GTI-seq is to use a translation inhibitor lactimidomycin (LTM) that is capable of completely freezing the initiating ribosomes. Unlike the commonly used translation inhibitor cycloheximide, LTM preferentially acts on the initiating ribosomes because it only binds to the empty E-site of the ribosome that is normally occupied by deacylated tRNA during elongation.

operations.label: RNase digestion
operations.description: Digest exposed portions of ribosome-associated RNA, leaving ribosome-protected RNA in the complex. The yellow icon is an agent acting at this step; neither its identity nor an additional material route is labeled.
operations.mechanism: Nuclease accessibility distinguishes exposed RNA from ribosome-protected mRNA. No particular RNase identity is specified in the drawing.
operations.information_effect: Encodes ribosome protection as surviving RNA-fragment boundaries; survival is a physical protection readout, not proof that every surviving sequence encodes a functional protein.

research_questions.question: GTI-Seq is an explicit target of the poster's single grouped upper row. The supplied Wan/Qian TISdb full text establishes an initiation-focused ribosome-profiling variant in which lactimidomycin preferentially freezes initiating ribosomes and their footprints report TIS positions. This supports the purpose and protected-fragment generation at op_rnase. The remaining drawn route stays in the family-level graph: the supplied GTI-Seq passages do not establish the particular two-extraction/rRNA-depletion preparation history of the downstream local instances. Reverse transcription has a matching footprint-to-DNA purpose, but that correspondence alone does not assign this exact downstream instance to GTI-Seq. The upstream inhibitor treatment is not drawn and is described here only to interpret the GTI-Seq target, not added as an operation. The collection page's harringtonine example is not evidence that GTI-Seq uses harringtonine.
